purpose: Delta of five additional ecosystems against the prior LabLaunchPad corpus

new_high_value_patterns.pattern: Durable agent state separate from memory/context
Context broker with progressive disclosure and compression
Tool trajectory evaluation separate from response quality
Deterministic action-boundary policy + sandbox, not LLM-only security
Autonomy vs deterministic workflow as separate modes
Role/task metadata for human mental model, not mandatory orchestration

new_research_gaps: Cross-framework reproduction on identical tasks and providers
exact dependency-license inventories and documentation copyright terms
quantified coordination break-even for multi-agent vs single-agent execution
memory poisoning/staleness benchmarks across persistent-agent frameworks
runtime escape testing across local, Docker, cloud browser and managed runtimes
exact context token accounting across current framework releases
architecture_status: No rewrite performed; conflicting evidence becomes ADR-CANDIDATE.
